title: A $69 Pine+ price wins FY27 and loses on each new cohort
subtitle: Member lifetime value is rising within each plan type but flat overall, because more members now join on the monthly plan. Raising the annual price from $59 to $69 would add about $1.1M in FY27 at real downside risk. $65 captures most of that gain with far less risk.
summary: Three-year contribution LTV is $418 for annual Pine+ members and $189 for monthly members. Blended LTV is slipping because 29% of new joiners now choose monthly. Raising the annual price from $59 to $69 adds about $1.1M in FY27 in the central case but risks −$2.1M, so we recommend $65 from February 2027 and a year-end FY27 base of about 540k members.
key_findings: 3-year contribution LTV is $418 for annual-plan members and $189 for monthly-plan members (2025 cohort).
The share of joiners choosing monthly rose from 14% (2023) to 29% (2026 H1), pulling blended LTV per new member from $366 to $355 even though both plans improved.
Price tests at $69 cut annual renewal by 3.9 pp (67.8% to 63.9%) and join rate by 6%.
FY27 contribution vs. holding at $59: +$0.9M at $65, +$1.1M at $69 central, −$2.1M at $69 downside.
We forecast 548k members at the end of FY27 at $59 (80% range 522–574k), 540k at $65 and 531k at $69.
